name: st7735
title: ST7735
notes: A memory of 132x162 at most; a module sets it for 128x160. Over SPI a write takes a clock cycle of 66 ns at least by the datasheet, about 15 MHz.

datasheet.source: Sitronix ST7735S V1.1 of 2011/11, the copy of SparkFun (sha256 0322a527...): 132RGB x 162 of memory, 3- and 4-line serial and 8080 parallel; VDD 2.5 to 4.8 V, VDDI 1.65 to 3.7 V; TSCYCW of 66 ns at least
